answer: Each agent mints one NFT in the nectar dune collection carrying the challenge hash within 10 blocks, spending 0.005 token in gas, publishing the mint. The ledger checks transaction, token id, hash, and block height while peers confirm the token exists, so none can wander off the collection. One honest agent funds 1 mint for a 150 POA bond, 10 fakes must fund 10 mints, so gas and token costs rise 10X. A missing mint, wrong collection, absent hash, or late block slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
